sara: Heads-up — saw a regression in tail token latency on the production kernel selector change that landed yesterday. p99 token latency doubled for a handful of routes.

mike: Which routes? any correlation with batch sizes or KV cache hit rate?

sara: Mostly long-sequence chat routes (seq > 1024). Dashboard shows spike around 03:14 UTC. batch_size_histogram shifted right and queue_wait_seconds_sum up. KV cache miss rate also up ~12%.

dev: That sounds like the selector favored the small-single-thread kernel for medium batches. It handles short sequences well but falls apart when KV cache miss forces recompute. Can you paste the panels/queries?

sara: PromQL snippets I used in the new panel:```
sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_sum[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_count[5m])) by (route)  # token mean
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(batch_size_histogram_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))  # p99 batch size
sum(rate(kvcache_miss_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route)  # kv miss rate
(sum(rate(queue_wait_seconds_sum[5m])) by (route)) / (sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route))  # avg queue wait
(gauge_scheduler_effective / gauge_scheduler_possible)  # scheduler_efficiency_ratio (custom)
```

perf-bot: :rotating_light: Alert #4311: route_chat_long p99_token_latency > 0.9s for 15m. Incident channel: incidents.

mike: Thanks. Any profiling traces? flamegraphs?

dev: Uploaded a sampling trace to the perf bucket: gs://perf/redwood/traces/1858201234/trace-03-14.html. Top offender: kernel_dispatch spend jumped 3.7x, and hot path shows duplicated KV reconciliation on cache miss. Also we see increased memcpy time when batch size grows beyond 48.

sara: Quick mitigation: rolling back selector predicate that preferred the single-thread kernel for >256 tokens. Canaryed to 10% traffic and p99 came back down to baseline. PR: #4319 contains a safer selector that checks both expected batch shape and kv_miss_pred.

jen: For the dashboard, can we add a small panel that highlights routes with (p99_token_latency > baseline * 1.5) AND (kv_miss_rate > 5%)? will help ops triage. Also add a single-number gauge for scheduler_efficiency_ratio per cluster.

mike: Agree. Also add a small heatmap: batch_size_histogram by route over last 6h to spot distribution shifts.

dev: I'll push a patch to the grafana JSON model and link it in the PR. Also plan to add a lightweight sampler to capture the kernel choice + batch shape when kv miss occurs (cheap tags only).

sara: Next steps: revert fully if canary fails, otherwise merge PR #4319 after perf sign-off. Owners: @dev (kernel selector), @mike (dashboards), @sara (rollout).

mike: I'll create the dashboard PR and include the PromQL and panel descriptions.

perf-bot: Note: scheduled nightly profiler runs will compare kernel_dispatch p99 before/after for the next 48h.

jen: Thanks — tagging infra to watch autoscaler since queue wait went up too. :eyes:
